subject: Request for Additional Customer Data
body:
Dear Jane Doe,

We hope this message finds you well. As part of our ongoing partnership with Union Trust Bank, we are reaching out to request additional data to further our customer engagement analysis. Specifically, we are looking for recent transaction history and account balance information that could provide us with insights into customer spending patterns. We believe that this data is crucial for refining our marketing strategies and delivering value to the bank's advertising efforts.

We understand the importance of maintaining customer confidentiality and assure you that all data provided will be used solely for the purpose of this project and will be handled in accordance with the highest standards of privacy and security.

Please send us the requested data at your earliest convenience. If you have any questions or need further clarification, feel free to contact us.

Best regards,

Alex Johnson
Data Analyst
MarketMinds Inc.
